materials_exhausted.notes: XML/PDF/OA package, Figure S1/supplement surfaces, publisher HTML landing assets, and linked database snapshots were checked. The only missing numerical surface is not recoverable because the paper reports hemolysis qualitatively without peptide-specific EC50 values; this is a nonblocking caution because qualitative toxicity evidence is preserved.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 matched DBAASP/DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP rows to Table 1 sequence notation and Table 3/Table 4 LD99.9 rows where possible; aggregate or name-conflated rows remain source_conflict with record IDs.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered 51 Table 3 LD99.9 rows, 7 Table 4 serum LD99.9 rows, and qualitative non-hemolysis rows for all Table 1 peptides. No database-only row is used as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced placeholder mechanism notes with bounded source-located mechanism context and avoided direct killing-mechanism overclaims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original rework ticket is closed because gate-changing local material was recovered or explicitly preserved as nonblocking conflict/caution; no blocking or major issue remains.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the empty activity layer, reconciled linked database rows against primary Tables 1, 3, and 4, preserved aggregate database conflicts, and bounded mechanism claims to paper-local evidence. The paper is publication-grade accepted with cautions, not accepted clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP02842 links this DOI but aggregates LfcinB(20-25) annotations and non-paper activity/hemolysis references; source-reviewed Lfc1 rows remain separate.
Two entry-level CAMP/dbAMP rows conflate Com6/Com7 names or values. They remain source_conflict while source-supported Table 3/Table 4 rows are retained.
The paper reports no peptide was hemolytic and defines EC50 in methods, but does not provide peptide-specific numeric EC50 values. Final toxicity rows preserve qualitative non-hemolysis only.
Mechanism-related source text is largely background or serum-albumin context; no direct bacterial membrane permeabilization assay is promoted.
